business.description: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited operates a fully integrated business model covering design, fabrics, and garments. The company manufactures circular knitted fabrics (natural, synthetic, open & tubular width) and specialized finishes (Teflon, stain resistance, Viscose, Lycra), and produces garments including women's wear (tees, leggings), men's wear (t-shirts, sweat shirts, pullovers, polo), and kids wear (t-shirts, sweat shirts, pullovers, polo, joggers).

outlook.statement: Focus is to improve the bottom line of the company. Plan to reduce long term debts and strengthen working capital further. Confident of long-term prospects for the industry and the company.

Targeting growth in the next financial year. The Company has explored new markets and buyers and is going good with recently obtained buyers. The sale of more environment friendly products has increased.

The future seems to be good for the Indian Textile Industry both at domestic and international levels as India is still maintaining itself as an attractive destination for retail industry and foreign investments. The Company's product mix is more focused on sustainability having innovative finishes and accordingly it is ready to cater to the domestic and international markets.

Indian textiles and apparel market projected to grow at 10% CAGR to reach US$ 350 billion by 2030. Indian Technical Textiles market projected to grow to US$ 45 billion by 2026, US$ 123 billion by 2035, and US$ 309 billion by 2047. India mobiltech textile market projected to grow from US$ 2.32 billion in FY25 to US$ 4.57 billion by FY33 at CAGR 8.84%. India's home textile market projected to grow at CAGR 7.08% during 2026-2031, reaching US$ 16.76 billion by 2031.
